title: Ashington medium to launch autobiography at haunted Chillingham Castle
excerpt: An Ashington medium is set to launch his autobiography at one of England’s most haunted castles.
content:
James at Chillingham Castle (Image: Highlights PR)

This article is brought to you by our exclusive subscriber partnership with our sister title USA Today, and has been written by our American colleagues. It does not necessarily reflect the view of The Herald.

An Ashington medium is set to launch his autobiography at one of England’s most haunted castles.

James Leighton, who describes himself as the 'Extra Large Medium', will unveil his life story at Chillingham Castle in Northumberland on November 3.

Mr Leighton said: "When I was growing up in Hexham, I honestly didn't think there was anything unusual about talking to the children in the Abbey graveyard.

"It was just something that happened and was part of my life.

"Looking back now, I realise those early experiences were probably the beginning of a journey that I could never have imagined."

Chillingham Castle is known for its supernatural reputation, making it a fitting location for the launch.

Mr Leighton has built a national following for his evidential mediumship, which focuses on delivering specific, recognisable messages to audience members.

He began his career performing in small pubs and social clubs across the North East, but now regularly sells out shows across the UK and Ireland.

His autobiography traces his life from a childhood in Hexham to becoming a professional medium, and includes personal stories from his tours.
